prompt: A small upright gecko-like fire lizard creature for a monster-collecting RPG. It sits back on large hind feet with short forelimbs held near its chest. Big head about a third of its height, side-set slit eye, no ears. A long tail curls up over its back and ends in a round glowing amber ember bulb, like a coal carried in a lantern. Sandstone tan hide with warm umber stripes, a cream angular throat mark, a faint amber zigzag marking along its flank, three-toed feet. Three-quarter view facing right, perched mid-hop, glancing back at its glowing tail. Crisp dark outline, alert and curious. On a plain white background.
